intro.prompt: 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080, about 8 seconds, photorealistic and cinematic, bright vivid colour. Setting: close view of a velvet tray of gold bangles and chains on a jeweller's counter in an Indian shop, cold dim evening light, the shop lamp switched off behind, the lower fifth a plain dark wooden counter top. Time of day and light, overriding anything darker in the setting above: bright golden-hour sunlight or clear daylight, a blue or golden sky, warm saturated colours, his face and clothes fully lit; never night, dusk, storm clouds, lightning, fog, grey overcast, a dark or desaturated look. The background is real and in motion behind him (as fits the place: waves, mist, leaves, flags, lamps flickering, people walking, traffic, light shifting); never a still, flat or heavily blurred backdrop. Movement and framing: like a TV news reporter on location, he walks toward the camera while he speaks: he starts three or four steps back, seen from the knees up, walks steadily and confidently toward the lens, and stops at a medium shot from the waist up for the last words. His whole head and both shoulders stay inside the frame the whole time, with clear space above his hair and on both sides; do not crop the top of his head. Lighting: warm key light on the face, a soft rim light on the hair, matched to the scene; flattering, no harsh shadows, no dull or flat grey look. SG [locked] walking tall and lively, shoulders open, energetic and confident, wearing a royal blue blazer over a white shirt. His forehead is clean and bare: no tilak, no bindi, no vermilion or sandal-paste mark, no dot or line of any colour on his face. Speaks from the first frame, mouth matched to the words, steady eye contact with the lens. Face and delivery: an excited, high-energy presenter breaking a big story, full of life, as if he cannot wait to tell you. Bright, wide-awake eyes, lively eyebrows that lift on the question, a big, bright, genuine smile. On the question his voice rises with excitement as he strides closer. On the last line a big confident smile, a quick nod and a point at the viewer. Natural blinking, lively head movement. Never sad, gloomy, worried, tired, sleepy, flat or bored; never a frown, never a blank face. Voice: energetic, upbeat, punchy and clear, a brisk pace, rising on the question, with a quick beat before the last line. Hands: energetic, natural gestures at chest height: a quick point toward the scene behind him on the question and an open palm toward the viewer on the last line; never limp, never hanging still by his sides. Camera: eye level, steady, holding its place as he walks up to it (a very slight slow push-in at most), slight handheld feel. Empty hands, no prop. @SGLearning watermark in the top right corner, white, bold, 80% opacity. No captions, no subtitles, no other on-screen text. No hologram, no floating screen, no graph, no chart, no laptop, tablet, monitor, TV or glowing blue panel anywhere in the frame. Export at 1920x1080.

topic.summary: A detailed study of the recent gold and silver fall (founder, 28 Nov 2026: 'Do on sona aur chandi achanak se kyun gire. Detailed study'). The timeline day by day with peak and current prices (LBMA, MCX, COMEX; check every level and date); the drivers one by one: the dollar, interest-rate expectations, profit-booking after the rally, margin changes on the exchanges, central-bank buying; how silver fell further and why; what earlier falls such as 2011 and 2013 looked like and how long recovery took; what it means for a jewellery buyer, a gold-loan holder, an ETF or SGB saver; and the mistakes most buyers make at the top and at the bottom. Explanation only, no advice to buy or sell.
